source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.1 with Quick Check 22.1 answered, printed pages 86-87 (PDF 89-90).

blocks.text: Hydroxyl group (-OH) tamam alcohols ka functional group hai. Alcohols ka general formula ROH hai, jahan R ek alkyl group hai. Is family mein cholesterol aur carbohydrates jaisi jaani pehchani cheezein bhi shamil hain. Methanol (CH₃OH) aur ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH) monohydric alcohols ki homologous series (ek jaisi series) ke pehle do members hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke ROH mein R alkyl ya aryl group ho sakta hai. Agar -OH aryl (aromatic ring ke) carbon se jura ho to woh phenol hai, alcohol nahi; yeh baat kitab khud chapter ke shuru mein aur 22.5 mein kehti hai. Alcohol mein R alkyl group hota hai.
Jitne hydroxyl groups jure hon, us ke hisaab se alcohols do types ke hain: monohydric (ek -OH) aur polyhydric (ek se zyada -OH).

blocks.alt: Chaar alcohols: ethanol CH3CH2OH aur propan-1-ol CH3CH2CH2OH; 1,2-ethanediol (glycol), do CH2-OH units oopar neeche; aur 1,2,3-propanetriol (glycerol), CH2-OH, CH-OH aur CH2-OH oopar neeche.
blocks.caption: Monohydric aur polyhydric alcohols: ethanol, propan-1-ol, glycol aur glycerol (kitab ke PDF page 89 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ethanol aur propan-1-ol mein sirf ek -OH hai, is liye yeh monohydric hain. Glycol mein do aur glycerol mein teen -OH hain, har carbon par ek; yeh polyhydric hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab ne naam '1,2-ethandiol' aur '1,2,3-propantriol' chhape hain.
Sahi spelling: 1,2-ethanediol aur 1,2,3-propanetriol.
-OH wale carbon se seedha kitne carbon atoms jure hain, is hisaab se alcohols teen types ke hain:

items: Primary (1°) alcohol: -OH group primary carbon (jo sirf ek doosre carbon se jura ho) par hai. General formula R₁CH₂OH.
Secondary (2°) alcohol: -OH group secondary carbon (jo do carbons se jura ho) par hai. General formula R₂CHOH.
Tertiary (3°) alcohol: -OH group tertiary carbon (jo teen carbons se jura ho) par hai. General formula R₃COH.

blocks.alt: Teen general displayed structures, har aik mein carbon ke left R1 aur right OH: primary alcohol (oopar neeche H), secondary alcohol (oopar R2, neeche H) aur tertiary alcohol (oopar R2, neeche R3).
blocks.caption: Primary, secondary aur tertiary alcohols ke general structures (kitab ke PDF page 90 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: -OH wale carbon ko dekhein: us se kitne R groups (carbon) jure hain? Ek R (R₁) ho to primary, do (R₁, R₂) hon to secondary, teen (R₁, R₂, R₃) hon to tertiary. Baqi jagahon par H hain.

blocks.alt: Chhe skeletal alcohols, a se f: a) chaar carbon ki chain, methyl branch, OH chain ke end par; b) aik carbon jis par do methyl, aik ethyl aur OH; c) chaar carbon ki chain ke doosre carbon par OH; d) paanch carbon ki chain ke end par OH; e) chaar carbon ki chain ke doosre carbon par OH aur teesre par methyl; f) five-membered (paanch carbon wali) ring OH ke saath.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 22.1: primary, secondary ya tertiary batane ke liye alcohols (kitab ke PDF page 90 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaun se 1°, 2° aur 3° alcohols hain?
blocks.explanation: Drawings se parh kar: (a) 3-methylbutan-1-ol, primary; (b) 2-methylbutan-2-ol, tertiary; (c) butan-2-ol, secondary; (d) pentan-1-ol, primary; (e) 3-methylbutan-2-ol, secondary; (f) cyclopentanol, secondary.

items: Alcohols ka general formula ROH hai (R = alkyl group); -OH functional group hai.
-OH groups ki ginti se: monohydric (ek) aur polyhydric (do ya zyada, jaise glycol, glycerol).
Primary R₁CH₂OH, secondary R₂CHOH, tertiary R₃COH.
